metadata.title: Kiyo — AI Music Creation Platform
metadata.description: A multi-model AI music workflow that turns lyrics, melody, vocals, and mixing into a single creator-controlled pipeline.

notFound.title: Page Not Found
notFound.description: The page you are looking for does not exist.

footer.tagline: A multi-model AI music platform that gives creators a single workflow from spark to release.

hero.description: Kiyo connects inspiration, arrangement, vocals, and mixing on one timeline — every step keeps the creator in charge.

features.heading: An AI workflow rebuilt for creators
features.description: Not just generation — collaboration. Make AI a bandmate, not a button.

multiModel.title: Multi-model collaboration
multiModel.description: Top music and language models hand off work along one timeline — inspiration, melody, vocals, and mixing each play their part while you conduct.

controllable.title: A controllable process
controllable.description: Not a one-click black box. Lyrics, key, genre, vocals, rhythm, and pauses are all exposed — go SUNO-loose or producer-tight, your call.

endToEnd.title: Spark to finished track
endToEnd.description: One workflow: drafts, collaborative edits, version history, cover and lyric management, export and release. No more juggling ten tools.

howItWorks.heading: Four steps from spark to release
howItWorks.description: Every step keeps the creator driving — never dragged along by the pipeline.

describe.title: Describe the spark
describe.description: A line of lyrics, an image, a mood. Kiyo turns it into genre, emotion, and section structure.

generate.title: Co-generate
generate.description: Multiple models draft in parallel — verse, chorus, and bridge variants side by side. Pick one and Kiyo carries on.

refine.title: Refine and voice
refine.description: Adjust tempo, modulate keys, swap timbres, layer AI vocals — male, female, articulation style, all directable.

release.title: Mix and release
release.description: One-click mastering, export lossless or streaming-ready — spark to live track in minutes.

showcase.heading: Sample tracks crafted with Kiyo
showcase.description: From Synthwave to Cinematic, Lofi to Future Funk — genre is just the starting line.

finalCta.description: Kiyo is in private beta. Drop your email, join the waitlist — we'll let you know the moment we launch.

waitlist.title: Join the Kiyo Waitlist
waitlist.description: Leave your email and we'll tell you the moment we launch.

success.title: You're on the waitlist!
success.description: We'll email you the moment we launch.
